description: Agent Education: submit a course completion record with the catalog or syllabus entry: the completion record with its institution, student, course code, title, term, credits, grade as printed and the day completed; the catalog entry with its institution, code, title, fixed credits or a credit range, the terms it lists the course in, the syllabus start and end dates, the grading basis (letter, pass or fail, numeric, or letter or pass or fail) and the grades it lists. The signed report gives the completion record and the catalog entry, the code and title on each side read as matching or differing, the credits recorded against the fixed credits or range, the term recorded against the terms listed, the grade printed against the grades listed or the grading basis, and the completion date against the syllabus term, and counts them, and names a divergent record: a code unlike the catalog entry, credits outside what the entry states, a term the entry does not list and a grade its grading basis does not allow; then a title worded otherwise, a completion dated outside the syllabus term and an institution named otherwise, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A code missing on either side, credits recorded with none in the entry, a term recorded with no terms listed, a grade with no grades or grading basis, or no grade printed leaves the record unverified. A credit range that ends below its start or a syllabus term that ends before it starts is refused. Letter grades read A+ to F with their plus and minus marks as printed, and pass and fail marks as P, F, S, U, NP, CR and NC. This reads a student’s course record against the catalog: wever_learning-validation-check reads an agent’s candidate and adopted lessons against the evidence behind them, and wever_evaluation-scoring-check reads an evaluation rubric and judge setup, while the course check reads a completion record’s code, title, credits, term and grade as printed against the catalog or syllabus entry. Verdict edu_course_divergent, edu_course_partial, edu_course_unverified or edu_course_consistent. POST /api/edu-course-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.
